description:
This protocol performs the QPCR plate set-up protocol for library quantification step of NGS library prep.



Eppendorf twin.tec 96-well PCR plate 150ul #0030128605
Opentrons temperature module with 96-well aluminum block insert
Opentrons 4-in-1 tuberack with 4x6 insert for 2ml Eppendorf snapcap tubes or equivalent.
Opentrons 10ul and 200ul filter tipracks
Opentrons GEN1 P10 and P300 single-channel electronic pipettes



4x6 tuberack with 2ml Eppendorf snapcap tubes (slot 2)
 tubes A1-A5: water
 tube B1: QPCR mastermix
